title: Limit of the signed Hamming tail expectation
statement: For every real $t\ge0$, the uniform-cube expectation in dimension $m+1$ of the absolute value of the difference between the upper-tail indicators of the normalized Rademacher sum at $x$ and at $-x$ converges, as $m\to\infty$, to twice the standard Gaussian upper-tail probability at $t$.
